direct_reporting: Each microcompany employee reports solely to its existing delegated subagent parent, that parent reports to one original worker; then manager, director, OWNER.
slot_mapping: Zero-based sector_index = (slot-1)//25, task_index=(slot-1)%25; exactly 20*25=500 unique assignments per microcompany.

activation_policy.mode: lazy deterministic role definition; no materialization of 562,500,000 records
activation_policy.actual_inference: Run a bounded independent child-model call for one rotated micro-worker only when its direct parent subagent is actually executed on a real cloud runner.
activation_policy.public_source_behavior: Subordinate inference uses the parent research evidence; it does not flood GitHub, social sites or mailboxes with 562.5 million requests.
activation_policy.verify_result: Report whether model actually completed; role identity does not count as a living person, separate social account, employed person, or completed paid assignment.
activation_policy.scheduling_limit: Hardware, API, model and GitHub quotas constrain throughput; not all identities can or will run.

owner_mission: Only legitimately earned, transferable cryptocurrency verified as received at approved correct-network owner receiving routes counts as success. BTC mainnet and genuine USDC prioritized. No fiat-only settlement, airdrop claims, unverified token balances or fee-first opportunities.
privacy: No owner's name, family, private account details, wallet keys, full deposit map or custodial memos are provided to public role definitions.
prohibited_actions: self-replication beyond approved 500 roles per subagent
